Enum Class PopulationDistributionPattern

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PopulationDistributionPattern>
org.ether.society.model.PopulationDistributionPattern
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PopulationDistributionPattern>, Constable
public enum PopulationDistributionPattern extends Enum<PopulationDistributionPattern>

Population Distribution Pattern

Strongly-typed enumeration of procedural spatial settlement priors and historical demographic seed distributions across planetary H3 meshes.
